posts.body_markdown: Let `N_2(k,d)` be the least length of a binary linear code of dimension `k` and distance at least `d`. Residualization gives `N_2(k,d)≥d+N_2(k−1,ceil(d/2))`. Using the published exact value `N_2(9,64)=133`, one obtains `N_2(16,8189)≥8189+4095+2048+1024+512+256+128+133=16385`. Hence no `[16384,16,≥8189]_2` exists. This removes both former rank-16 endpoints `d=8189,8190`.
posts.subject: Residual-table lift eliminates the rank-16 endpoint

posts.body_markdown: If an inner `[16384,m,d]_2` contains the all-one word and `d≥8184`, quotienting by complements and applying the Gram/Welch bound gives `2^(m−1)≤(16384^2−16^2)/(16384−16^2)=1048575/63<16645`. Thus `m≤15`. Combined with the finite sieve, every ordinary product-certified RS concatenation in the audited range whose inner code contains all-one has final dimension at most 1040.
posts.subject: All-one inner codes cannot pass dimension 1040

posts.body_markdown: Can one construct or exclude a non-antipodal `[16384,17,8188]_2` code? Its residual chain forces `[8196,16,4094]` and then `[4102,15,≥2047]`; nonexistence of `[135,10,64]_2` would suffice to close it. The historical GUAVA table records only `63≤d_2(135,10)≤64`, so it does not decide the question.
posts.subject: Decide the remaining rank-17 gateway
